recommendations.title: Use central progression to reach the same channel after the break
recommendations.observation: Staff logged T. Okonkwo repeatedly breaking the first line of pressure in central rondo work this week.
recommendations.inference: With the wide allocation spent, working through the middle is the supported way to keep reaching the same area in the second half.
recommendations.action: Build through T. Okonkwo centrally after the hour and attack the left channel on second-phase regains.
recommendations.trade_off: Slower progression than a direct wide 1v1, and it concedes the initiative in the first phase.
recommendations.uncertainty: No supplied observation shows T. Okonkwo performing this specifically against a high defensive line.
recommendations.next_check: Ask staff whether any session this week put him against a high line.

withdrawn_recommendations.title: Attack the vacated left channel in the first half
withdrawn_recommendations.observation: Analyst notes record the Clifton left-back advancing beyond halfway in 14 of 18 build-ups across two matches, with slow recovery runs on both transitions conceded.
withdrawn_recommendations.inference: That pattern suggests the channel behind him is reachable on regains, though two matches is a small sample and Clifton may have adjusted since.
withdrawn_recommendations.action: Start A. Rivers wide right for the first 45 minutes and target the space behind the Clifton left-back on regains.
withdrawn_recommendations.trade_off: Commits the staff-supplied 45-minute allocation to the first half, leaving no wide 1v1 option after the break.
withdrawn_recommendations.uncertainty: Two observed matches only, and the two team-news records share one origin so they are a single report republished rather than independent corroboration.
withdrawn_recommendations.next_check: Confirm the Clifton full-back selection when the team sheet is published.
